Independent F2 simplex enumeration from graph disjoint edges gave all six stated face counts and Betti groups.

correctness.rationale: The assigned package defines M(P_n) as the simplicial complex of disjoint GRAPH EDGES, not perfect matchings and not the graph independent-set complex itself. The inspected complete Morse certificate supplies edge orders for n=3..8, enumerates every matching face, pairs Hasse covers by ordered toggles, and tests acyclicity of the entire directed Hasse graph. Critical counts are (one 0-cell plus respectively 6 cells degree1, 4 degree2, 2 degree2 plus 2 degree3, 12 degree3, 14 degree4, and 4 degree4 plus 8 degree5). At n=5 the complete 2x2 signed degree-3-to-2 Morse boundary is zero; at n=8 the 8x4 signed Morse boundary has rank one with a unit minor. Since pi_k of a wedge of k-spheres is Z^r for k>=2, these integral attaching maps cancel a primitive pair, yielding M(P_8)≃3 S4∨7 S5 and the other asserted wedges. The code explicitly determines every gradient path and signed boundary, so the finite statement is exhaustive. A separately written direct simplicial bitset boundary implementation recovered mod-2 reduced Betti vectors (6),(4),(2,2),(12),(14),(3,7) and face counts 31,107,341,1103,3543,11395 for n=3..8; mod-two corroborates but cannot alone certify integer wedge homotopy.
risks: Finite n=3..8 only; no global ladder recurrence or all-n homotopy theorem is inferred.
Independent F2 ranks do not establish integral torsion-freeness; that depends on inspected signed Morse certificate and integral attaching argument.
